text:
Type: white soft-shade table lamp
Use: soft mood light on a side table, sideboard or nightstand; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: textured white paper-like shade, white powder-coated metal stem, white tray base
Colors: white, warm glow
Shape: soft paneled bell shade with gentle vertical ribs, thin straight stem, round shallow tray base for keys or jewelry, light and simple, medium height
Feel: calm, soft, airy, cozy
Goes with: light wood, white walls, linen, pale grey; Scandinavian or minimalist bedrooms and living rooms
